description_full:
🚨 WE'RE HIRING!

🎨 INFOGRAPHIC & VISUAL COMMUNICATION INTERN

Make it simple. Make it visual. Make it persuasive.

Wearology is looking for a creative, analytical thinker who can transform complex information into clear, engaging, and persuasive visuals!

✨ WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Create engaging infographics, marketing content, and product guides.
• Simplify technical information into intuitive, consumer-friendly visuals.
• Develop persuasive copywriting and visual storytelling.
• Design packaging, labels, brochures, and other print materials.
• Prepare print-ready artwork with accurate bleed, dielines, and print specifications.

🎯 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
• DKV students or fresh graduates preferred. Advertising and Communication majors are also welcome.
• Strong visual-verbal aptitude and analytical thinking.
• Excellent visual hierarchy, infographic design, and concise copywriting skills.
• Understanding of persuasive communication and consumer psychology.
• Familiar with Adobe Illustrator and print production.
• Creative, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.

📍 Jakarta Barat | Work From Office
🕙 Monday–Friday | 10.00–18.00 WIB
📅 6-Month Internship

📩 HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV + Portfolio to:
hello.wearology@gmail.com

Email Subject:
CV_Name_Visual Communication Intern

Portfolio samples featuring infographics, marketing creatives, or print design are highly preferred.
